final:
settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["level", "color"], ["5", "red"]) == ["fast", "5", "red"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  var ks: List[str] = []
  var vs: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    let v = copy values[i]
    if k == "mode"
      mode = v
      continue
    if k == "level"
      level = v
      continue
    var found = False
    for j in range(0, ks.len())
      if ks[j] == k
        vs[j] = copy v
        found = True
    if found == False
      ks.append(copy k)
      vs.append(copy v)
  var res: List[str] = [mode, level]
  for v in vs
    res.append(copy v)
  res
